title: Openbox 2026 Modernization Initiative
instructions: Transform the 2004-era Openbox window manager into a modern, multi-platform window management system for 2026. This is a meta-project that will spawn multiple sub-projects for modular development. Goals: Wayland support, modern build system (Meson), Rust/C++ core options, CSS-based theming, JSON configuration, and modern tooling.

1784282772.4283493.instruction:
Replace the GNU Autotools build system with Meson. This sub-project includes:
- Create meson.build files for root and all subdirectories (obt/, obrender/, openbox/, tools/, data/, po/)
- Port all configure.ac checks to Meson (dependency detection, feature flags)
- Ensure all compiler flags, defines, and dependencies are properly translated
- Create meson_options.txt for optional features (startup-notification, xcursor, imlib2, librsvg)
- Test builds on Linux, ensure cross-compilation works
- Keep backward compatibility: generate configure script from meson for transitional period
- Deliverable: Fully functional Meson build that produces identical binaries to Autotools

log.text: Created comprehensive Meson build system with 15 meson.build files across all directories, meson_options.txt with 11 feature options, Autotools compatibility scripts (configure, Makefile), and detailed documentation

Verified all 15 meson.build files are in place across root, obt/, obrender/, openbox/, tools/, tools/gdm-control/, tools/gnome-panel-control/, tools/obxprop/, data/, data/autostart/, data/gnome-session/, data/gnome-wm-properties/, data/xsession/, po/, and scripts/ directories

1784282772.4285192.instruction:
Design and implement a platform abstraction layer to support both X11 and Wayland backends. This is the foundation for Wayland support:
- Create new directory openbox/platform/ with abstract interfaces
- Define platform-agnostic types: ObDisplay, ObWindow, ObSurface, ObSeat
- Refactor X11-specific code from openbox/*.c into openbox/platform/x11/
- Key files to abstract: display.c (X11 connection), event.c (X11 events), screen.c (X11 screens), frame.c (X11 windows)
- Ensure all current X11 functionality works through abstraction layer
- Design Wayland protocol interfaces (wl_compositor, wl_shell, xdg_shell)
- Deliverable: Working X11 backend through abstraction layer, ready for Wayland implementation

log.text: Created complete Platform Abstraction Layer with 13 source files: ob_platform.h/c (core interface), x11_backend.h with x11_display.c, x11_events.c, x11_window.c (full X11 implementation), wayland_backend.h with wayland_display.c, wayland_window.c (Wayland foundation), meson.build integration, and comprehensive documentation. Defines platform-agnostic types ObDisplay, ObWindow, ObSurface, ObSeat, ObMonitor with full event translation system.

1784282772.4297807.instruction:
Replace XML-based configuration with modern JSON (or TOML) with JSON Schema validation:
- Create new config format in JSON/TOML with equivalent expressiveness to rc.xml and menu.xml
- Design JSON Schema for rc.json and menu.json with full validation
- Implement new config parser using a modern library (json-glib or yyjson)
- Create migration tool: automatically convert existing rc.xml → rc.json
- Update all config reading code in openbox/config.c to use new format
- Maintain backward compatibility: auto-detect format, support both XML and JSON
- Add config hot-reload with validation error reporting
- Deliverable: JSON config system with schema validation, migration tool, and documentation

1784282772.4299953.instruction:
Replace the proprietary themerc format with CSS-based theming using a subset of CSS3:
- Research CSS parsing libraries (cssom, libcss, or custom parser)
- Design CSS mapping: window decorations, borders, titlebars, buttons, menus
- Create CSS properties for Openbox-specific features (grips, handles, button positions)
- Implement CSS cascade and inheritance for theme properties
- Create theme converter: migrate existing themes to CSS format
- Update obrender/theme.c to render from CSS rules
- Support CSS variables for dynamic theming (dark/light mode)
- Deliverable: CSS theme engine with 3 converted example themes, documentation

1784282772.4301105.instruction:
Create a modern Rust implementation of Openbox core as an alternative to C:
- Set up Rust project structure with Cargo workspace
- Use bindgen to generate FFI bindings for existing C libraries (obrender, obt)
- Rewrite critical modules in Rust: client management, focus tracking, stacking
- Implement memory-safe window state management
- Use Rust's concurrency for event handling and IPC
- Maintain C API compatibility for plugins and tools
- Create comprehensive Rust tests using cargo test
- Deliverable: Functional Rust core that can replace C core, with feature parity tests

1784282772.4302194.instruction:
Replace signal-based control with modern D-Bus IPC and rich CLI:
- Implement D-Bus service org.openbox.WindowManager with introspection
- Expose methods: Reconfigure, Restart, Exit, GetWindows, FocusWindow, MoveWindow, etc.
- Add signals for window events: WindowCreated, WindowFocused, WindowClosed
- Create new obctl command-line tool (Rust or Python) using D-Bus
- Deprecate --reconfigure, --restart, --exit signal interface (keep for compatibility)
- Add introspection and documentation generation from D-Bus XML
- Implement async event subscription for scripts
- Deliverable: D-Bus service, obctl CLI tool, Python bindings example

1784282772.43033.instruction:
Establish modern testing infrastructure and continuous integration:
- Set up pytest with pytest-xvfb for X11 integration tests
- Create headless window manager tests using Xvfb or Xwayland
- Implement property-based testing for window operations (Hypothesis)
- Add memory safety tests with Valgrind and AddressSanitizer
- Set up GitHub Actions CI: build matrix (GCC, Clang, different distros)
- Add code coverage reporting (gcov + codecov)
- Create Docker containers for reproducible builds
- Add static analysis: clang-tidy, cppcheck, clippy (for Rust)
- Deliverable: CI pipeline with tests, coverage reports, and build artifacts

1784282772.4304533.instruction:
Modernize all documentation with contemporary tools and formats:
- Convert SGML man pages to Markdown with scdoc or pandoc
- Set up MkDocs or mdBook for comprehensive documentation site
- Create API documentation using Doxygen → Sphinx/Breathe
- Write architecture decision records (ADRs) for all major changes
- Create contributor guide with coding standards and PR process
- Add inline code documentation for all public APIs
- Create video tutorials for theme creation and configuration
- Deliverable: Documentation website, updated man pages, contributor guide

1784282772.4305706.instruction:
Improve integration with modern desktop ecosystems and create extension API:
- Implement xdg-desktop-portal support for sandboxed apps
- Add systemd user service integration with proper activation
- Create extension API for plugins (C ABI stable interface)
- Implement common extensions: compositor effects, tiling modes, window rules
- Add Lua or JavaScript scripting support for user customization
- Create Python bindings for automation and testing
- Integrate with display managers (GDM, SDDM, LightDM) for session management
- Deliverable: Extension API, example plugins, Python bindings, portal implementation

1784282772.430687.instruction:
Prepare modern packaging and distribution for multiple platforms:
- Create Flatpak manifest for sandboxed distribution
- Add AppImage build script for universal Linux binary
- Update Debian/Ubuntu packaging (deb) with modern standards
- Create RPM spec for Fedora/openSUSE
- Add Homebrew formula for macOS (if XQuartz support maintained)
- Set up automated release process with signed tarballs and checksums
- Create migration guide from Openbox 3.6 to 4.0
- Set up announcement channels (Mastodon, Reddit, Hacker News)
- Deliverable: All packaging formats, release automation, migration guide
